data.name: Baldric
data.gender_notes: Baldric is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'bald' (bold, brave) and 'ric' (ruler, power). The name Baldric carries the meaning “Brave ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Baldric usually hope their child will grow to embody brave ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and bravery in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Baldric belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baldric total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Baldric was popular in medieval Europe, particularly among the nobility and knights. It represented strength, courage, and leadership, embodying the ideals of a brave warrior or a powerful ruler. The name Baldric is still found in some families with ancient lineages.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Baldric can be seen as a reminder of God's gift of bravery and power to His people. It can be interpreted as a call to exhibit courage and faith in God as a ruler or a warrior in life. Additionally, the name's association with the ancient Germanic cultures can symbolize the hanld of God guiding and protecting his people throughout history.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Baldric: Strong ruler in God. The name Baldric means bold or ruler, symbolizing one who boldly leads with God's guidance.
